entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins, order number is 9987-B. Look, I don't need a whole song and dance, I just want to know how to send this VeloBand back.
I understand, Sarah. I've pulled up your order. Just to make sure I'm guiding you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue with it. Honestly, it was just an impulse buy around the holidays. I've basically changed my mind and I just don't use it. Can I return it or not?

Okay, thanks for clarifying. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago. For that specific model, due to how it activates and links to a user's account, we have a strict 10-day return window. We are outside of that period, so I'm unable to process a refund.
You're kidding. So I'm just stuck with a hundred-and-fifty-dollar paperweight? That's ridiculous.

Not at all. While a direct return isn't possible, we do have a great option. We run an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It’s very popular for customers in your exact situation. You can list your band there for another VeloFit enthusiast to purchase.
A resale marketplace? How much of a hassle is that? I don't have time to deal with a complicated listing.

It's a very straightforward process. Since you bought it directly from us, most of the product information will auto-populate. You just set your price and add a photo. I can email you the direct link right now.
Fine. That's better than nothing. Send the link to the email on my account.
Absolutely. I've just sent that email with the subject 'Your VeloFit Resale Marketplace Link'. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
